allocation.rule: pair seeds derive from (history_seed, pair_index) under the frozen domain tag; distinct index bands guarantee disjoint reference/control seeds from pair seeds; group key = pair seed keeps every variant of one seed in one split.

calibration.dependence: paired twin/abnormal arms share the pre-injection source, so the two MMD arms are NOT independent samples; the cross-term couples them. The independent unit across groups is the binary response (above/below the frozen q95), not the MMD value itself.
calibration.encoder_role: run replicates summarized by median, never independent data
calibration.null_unit: one matched-size normal-normal twin group (K=8 twin embeddings per arm)

reference_pool.bandwidth: median pairwise distance on the causal reference pool

calibration.statistic: unbiased MMD^2 (E1, primary) between the two K=8 arms
calibration.threshold: frozen q95 per (family x severity) cell per encoder seed

clopper_pearson_reference.response_fraction_note: fraction = share of scored groups above the frozen null q95; 0.5 is a PROPOSED bar on that fraction, never a raw E1 value.

evaluation.duration_scope: duration_anomaly pairs within family only, never cross-family evidence

stage1.contrast: unbiased E1: K=8 twin embeddings vs K=8 abnormal embeddings (same family x severity, disjoint seeds)
stage1.grouping: group key = pair seed; every variant (twin + all family/severity abnormals) of one seed stays in one split. Reference pool seeds are disjoint from pair/control seeds. Anomaly labels never enter encoder, reference, prototype, bandwidth or detector fits.
stage1.independent_unit: one scored group of K=8 paired sources
stage1.no_transfer: M15 per-pair sign/t power is not transferred; group-level power above governs
stage1.proposed_bar: E1 response fraction >= 0.5 with the exact lower bound above the measured false-alarm anchor
stage1.summary: detection fraction over G independent groups with exact Clopper-Pearson interval

stage2.dilution_ladder: low/mid must show monotone non-increasing response (descriptive)
stage2.primary: E1 transition median above the context-only control q95 at elevated burden, weekly and monthly
stage2.rounding: n_abnormal = floor(b * N + 0.5), inherited from M13
stage2.uncertainty: history-cluster bootstrap, B=2000, seed 2407, descriptive at small n; no pair-level bootstrap

execution.business_baseline_rule: low-nonzero burden in [0.02, 0.10]; pure normal is diagnostic control only
execution.grouping_rule: group key = pair seed; every variant (twin + all family/severity abnormals) of one seed stays in one split. Reference pool seeds are disjoint from pair/control seeds. Anomaly labels never enter encoder, reference, prototype, bandwidth or detector fits.

expansion.beyond_48: NOT AUTHORIZED: no 96 cap-only branch, no gray-zone expansion path; any G>48 needs a separate explicit owner authorization with recomputed operating characteristics.
expansion.rule: the 24->48 step is the predeclared plan; both results publish.

interim_look.rule: at G=24, a family at or below the measured false-alarm anchor (cap 0.1) stops for futility; no optional stopping beyond this rule; no outcome-based metric selection.

sequential_multiplicity.misses: INCONCLUSIVE: a missed 0.5 response-fraction bar is never read as absence. No REPRESENTATION negative without a separately owner-approved relevant-effect margin plus a valid upper-confidence-bound computation against it (none exists).

multiplicity.rule: Holm step-down over the declared primary contrasts (per family, alpha=0.05); per-cell detection fractions report exact intervals regardless of disposition.

supersession: A01 (S24-PAIRED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-A01) is preserved byte-identical as the immutable historical record; C2 authorizes the complete official matrix path that A01 explicitly forbade.
